task.description: Design the EntityDefinition JSON shape, 11 structural validation rules, canonicalisation reuse, and logical-shape versioning for REQ-225.

result.note: Design written to lib/letflow/design/req225-entity-definition-schema-validation.md. Key decisions: (1) module placement is a new lib/letflow/entities/ namespace (Letflow.Entities.Definition / .Validator / .Shape), not lib/letflow/repository/, since this is document-shape/validation logic distinct from generic content-addressed storage. (2) Ownership model resolved EXPLICITLY as tenant-scoped (design section 1), reasoned from the existing tenant-scoped convention shared by Letflow.Repository and Letflow.EventStore.Registry, plus the unscoped cross-tenant-sharing question a platform-scoped model would open. (3) The 11-rules-vs-9-named-categories mismatch is resolved explicitly: cardinality limits are split into 4 lettered sub-rules (8a fields/8b indexes/8c FKs/8d constraints, concrete limits 200/32/32/32 stated as this design's own choice since R-Co source is unreachable from this sandbox, flagged as an open question), and field/index/constraint name uniqueness are folded into one rule (Rule 2) since AC2 names only one 'field uniqueness' category -- yielding exactly 11 independently-fixturable rules, each with a distinct violation `rule` atom. (4) Canonicalisation/hashing is pure delegation to the existing Letflow.Repository.Canonicaliser (canonicalize_content/2 + content_hash/1) -- no second canonicaliser designed. (5) Logical-shape versioning: strips display_name/description and treats fields/indexes/foreign_keys/constraints as name-keyed sets (order-insensitive) before canonicalising a probe document; 2 non-bumping and 2 bumping worked examples given. No entity_definitions migration, no persistence, no route/controller designed (explicitly listed as NOT built, per REQ-225 AC6). All 7 ACs mapped to design sections in a closing traceability table (section 10).
